claim: 小文件场景下年均请求次数估算公式：Req_annual = (Data_Volume_TB * 1024 * 1024 / Avg_Obj_Size_MB) * Access_Freq_Per_Obj_Per_Day * 365；代入 Data=500TB, Avg_Obj=1MB, Freq=1/day，则 Req_annual ≈ 500 * 1024 * 365 ≈ 1.87亿次/年 [knowledge]
